- confirmation of affected project(s)/API keys (you can share the project ID or a handful of request ids)
- the usage spike/failed requests slice you want included (we usually reconcile token counts on our side)
- whether you'd prefer a one‑time invoice credit or a formal SLA credit applied to future bills

From Redwood's side, we'll:
- produce an internal hourly availability/latency extract for 2026-08-18 00:00–08:00 UTC
- run our standard credit computation (per the SLA: window downtime, eligible tier, and prorated service hours)

I'm attaching a preliminary worksheet (makewhole-proposal-hallsystems.xlsx) with the calculation template. If you can confirm project IDs and preferred remedy by end of day Friday I will route for legal/finance review.

Looping in finance/legal guidance. Quick notes:
- We can approve invoice adjustments up to $25k administratively; anything above requires VP signoff.
- Standard SLA credit policy: prorated by hours impacted, capped at monthly 100% of that service's MRR.
- For Hall Systems (HS-4471) confirm whether they want cash‑style invoice adjustment or a credit ledger entry. Cash adjustment will push a negative invoice; credit will appear as a credit memo on their account.

If Mina can provide the reconciled usage slice we'll run the calculation and attach a one‑page summary for customer signoff. Also include a short statement for the DocuSign envelope: "Customer accepts the make‑whole calculation as final and releases Redwood from further claims for this incident."
